not_shown: a real device: the phone is simulated in this driver's process and every record it posts says sim: true
a radio or network effect: the round trip rises because the simulated device sleeps on the host before it posts
a CMDH policy: the rule is our own JSON object in a <container>; the CSE does not interpret it
a MEC platform's own policy check: the constraint and the violation check are our stand-in resources on each edge's MN-CSE; no MEC 010 / MEC 011 interface carried, enforced or raised anything
the app's <pollingChannel> downlink: the device here takes commands by notification to a point of access
an authenticated originator: the lab CSEs take X-M2M-Origin as given over plain HTTP on loopback; the engine pings and reads the constraints as the lab's admin originator
separate machines: 'edge A', 'edge B' and the IN-CSE are three processes on one PC
the constraint broken DURING a handover: the control breaks it after the handover completed and checks that the MEC-side check then raises a violation
agreement with any test suite: this is a demonstration of mechanisms, not a conformance claim
